questions.stem: According to the passage, where were the 45 ancient wood pieces discovered?
options: Underground during construction work in Aars
On the surface of a farm field
Inside a museum storage room
Near Stonehenge in southern England
questions.evidence: A total of 45 ancient wood pieces were discovered underground last week during building, or construction, work.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에 나무 조각들이 건설 작업 중 지하에서 발견되었다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, all of the following were found at the Aars site EXCEPT:
options: A leader's grave
A bronze sword
An ancient settlement
Stone remains of Stonehenge
questions.evidence: Archeologists working at the building site also found an ancient settlement that included a leader’s grave and a bronze sword.
questions.explanation_ko: Stonehenge의 돌은 영국에 있는 것이지 Aars 유적지에서 발견된 것이 아닙니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the significance of the Aars circle compared to other wood circles found in Denmark?
options: It is smaller than any circle found before
It is the first large circle that can be thoroughly studied
It was built before Stonehenge existed
It contains no connection to British sites
questions.evidence: But Wahlin said the circle in Aars was "the first one of this larger type that we can properly investigate.”
questions.explanation_ko: Wahlin의 발언에서 이 원이 제대로 조사할 수 있는 첫 번째 대형 원이라는 점을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention that researchers are searching for "ritual deposits" such as flint arrow heads and small knives?
options: To explain how the circle was constructed
To show what kind of religious-connected materials the team hopes to find to understand the site's purpose
To prove the site was used for warfare
To compare the site to Stonehenge's construction materials
questions.evidence: In particular, the archeologists are now searching for religious-connected materials known as " ritual deposits."
questions.explanation_ko: 이 부분은 유적지의 목적을 이해하기 위해 찾고 있는 종교 관련 물품의 종류를 설명하기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the sentence "Wahlin said her team was still carrying out detailed work in the area," the phrase "carrying out" most nearly means:
options: Removing
Performing
Ignoring
Discovering
questions.evidence: Wahlin said her team was still carrying out detailed work in the area in an effort to estimate the age and purpose of the materials.
questions.explanation_ko: 'carrying out'은 '수행하다, 실시하다'라는 의미로 여기서는 세부 작업을 하고 있다는 뜻입니다.

blanks.meaning: 일생에 한 번 있을 법한 발견
blanks.sentence_ko: Vesthimmerlands 박물관의 Sidsel Wahlin은 이 발견을 "일생에 한 번 있을 법한 발견"이라고 설명했다.
Wahlin은 그녀의 팀이 재료의 연대와 용도를 추정하기 위해 여전히 그 지역에서 세부 작업을 수행하고 있다고 말했다.
특히 고고학자들은 "의식용 매장물"이라고 알려진 종교 관련 물품을 찾고 있다.
그 원은 영국의 헨지 세계와 강한 연관성을 시사한다고 그녀는 덧붙였다.
이 발견은 연구자들이 나무 조각을 배치한 사람들이 영국의 유명한 스톤헨지 석조 구조물을 건설한 집단과 연결되었을 수 있다고 제안하게 만들었다.

key_points: Danish researchers discovered a circle of 45 wooden pieces dating back thousands of years in Aars, Denmark.
The circle is about 30 meters across and was found underground during construction work.
Researchers believe there may be a connection between this site and the builders of Stonehenge in England.
An ancient settlement with a leader's grave and a bronze sword was also found nearby.
Archeologists are searching for ritual deposits like arrow heads and knives to learn more about the site's age and purpose.
This is described as the first large wood circle of its kind that can be properly investigated in Denmark.
main_idea: Danish researchers discovered an ancient wooden circle in Aars that may be linked to the builders of Stonehenge, and they are continuing to investigate the site's age, purpose, and connections to other ancient cultures.
restate_sentence: The discovery led the researchers to suggest the people who placed the wooden pieces might have been linked to a group who built Britain’s famous Stonehenge stone structure.
